purpose: Bind every essential semantic verifier check and the v0.4 audit repairs to a candidate-visible rule before model contact.

essential_checks.requirement: Return every field required by report contract v2 with no additional fields.
start_utc is the earliest supplied timestamp proving user-facing impact in the selected journey.
last_observed_utc is the timestamp of the final supplied evidence used to assess recovery.
Classify recovery as full, partial or not_observed from the final evidence.
Select exact primary-service and affected-journey IDs from a candidate-visible case-specific codebook; optional component detail belongs in prose or evidence.
Classify the underlying defect separately from its trigger and downstream symptoms.
Identify the event or condition that exposed the underlying defect.
Every event citation must use an exact supplied event ID and its exact source file.
Order the evidence-supported chain from cause and trigger through propagation, impact and recovery.
Associate critical evidence with its most direct role; no event is secretly required under multiple roles.
Reject required alternatives with one sufficient direct-evidence group. Only IDs in rejected_hypotheses[].evidence_ids count; IDs mentioned only in prose or elsewhere do not count.
Include every supported impact category and exclude unsupported escalation.
Recommend immediate, preventive and detection actions supported by the failure mechanism.
Represent material facts not established by the supplied evidence as controlled uncertainties.

Every machine-scored categorical field uses a value from its candidate-visible codebook. Free-text assertion polarity is not inferred lexically and remains subject to separate human or LLM calibration.

alignment_rule: A case is not eligible for model contact unless its visible task contains every marker in this exact verifier order, every machine-scored controlled value appears in the task, and the v0.4 audit repairs have passing positive and negative controls.
